title: Grateful Dead Live at Patrick Gymnasium, University of Vermont on 1983-04-13
lineage: MAC > Sony TC-D5M (no Dolby) > Realtek AC97 > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 > FLAC.
source: Nakamichi CM-300's (no shotguns) > patched thru one Sony D5 > Marantz PMD-340 > TDK SA-90's. Mics on stand aprx six feet high, set up second or third row up in the bleachers directly behind the soundboard.

ai_review.summary: Vivid audience tape of a classic 1983 gym‑style show with clear, lively sound.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the concert’s high energy – calling it a “smoker” and a true gym atmosphere – and praise the recording for being clean and immersive. The tape captures the excitement of the spinners under the bleachers while delivering a punchy mix that lets listeners relive the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Three positive reviews (average 4.3 stars) highlight both an enthusiastic performance and a solid, clear recording; limited detail keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, punchy mix that captures the live energy; no reported drop‑outs, muddiness, or other issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans recall a high‑energy gym vibe with spinners and bleachers, indicating an overall enthusiastic performance throughout the set.
